about_short_description.short_description: Sweep.io creates CRM applications for scaling and customising SalesForce configurations.

product.name: Sweep Agentic Workspace
product.description: A collaborative visual platform that integrates with Salesforce and HubSpot to provide real-time documentation, data quality management, and AI-driven process optimization.

product.name: AI-powered Salesforce Documentation
product.description: Automated, real-time documentation and dependency mapping of Salesforce configurations to track changes and system relationships.

product.name: Salesforce Deduplication and Matching Engine
product.description: Automated deduplication and intelligent matching tools to maintain clean Salesforce data by removing duplicates and improving data quality.

product.name: Salesforce Lead Routing and Assignment
product.description: A native Salesforce lead routing system that manages groups, territories, and assignment rules to automate and optimize lead distribution.

product.name: Sweep Monitoring Agent
product.description: An AI-driven monitoring tool that continuously scans Salesforce environments for risks, technical debt, and compliance violations.

product.name: Salesforce Process Management Workspace
product.description: A visual, drag-and-drop workspace for designing, building, and deploying Salesforce sales processes and automations.
